q: Hjorth's turbulence theorem says that if a continuous Polish group action is turbulent, the orbit equivalence relation is NOT:
opts: Borel reducible to an orbit equivalence relation induced by a continuous S∞-action (no 'countable structure' classification)
exp: Hjorth (2000): turbulent actions produce orbit equivalence relations that cannot be classified by countable structures (graphs, groups, etc.). Turbulence = orbits are locally dense and locally meager. This is the main tool for proving anti-classification theorems.
